mostWorthwhile.text: Building the retina and optic nerve was most worthwhile: the picture connected the new names to a light-sensitive lining and an outgoing bundle of nerve fibres.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the finished eye to the body was fairly predictable, and the result did not show how the leaf becomes a sight.

surprise.text: I learned that the retina is the light-sensitive lining and the optic nerve is the bundle carrying signals onward.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the pictures and goals explained the pairings, even when the next step was predictable.

continue.text: I might continue to see how the brain makes sense of the signals. Building the eye was clear, but the final result left that part of sight unexplained.
